verdict.rationale: Delegating tasks to an assistant is Kimi's core function. The kimi.com entry point invites users to "do an Agent task", and the help center documents an agent mode with Agent clusters, scheduled tasks, deep research, agent-built and deployed web pages, and a PPT assistant. Kimi Code's agent autonomously reads code, edits files, runs commands, and verifies results. Community reports of overthinking or broken code describe output quality, not a missing capability, so they lower confidence slightly rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs for the consumer agent mode (help-center entries are only topic headings, including the stated limitations), and stronger independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.
